org.portico.bindings.jgroups

Class Roster

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.portico.bindings.jgroups.Roster
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    ConnectedRoster

    public class Roster
extends Object
implements ConnectedRoster
    Portico bindings each have to provide an implementation of the ConnectedRoster so that the framework can access membership information in a connection-neutral manner. This class provides that implementation for the JGroups binding, wrapping information from a Manifest.
